input_schema.description:
Reads one item: the `timeline.get` item summary plus its track, source, audio and visual
properties. `fields` limits the extra sections (`name`, `source`, `audio`, `visual`).

fields.description: Sections to include: any of `name`, `source`, `audio`, `visual` (default all).

input_schema.title: ItemGet

queries.name: item.get

item.description: The same projection `timeline.get` returns at depth 2.

enabled.description: Whether the item is rendered and heard.

start.description: Timeline position of the first frame.

linked.description: The other items of the linked group, if any.

name.description: The display name, if it has one (unless `fields` leaves it out).

source.description: Media and source position (unless `fields` leaves it out).

source_in.description: Position in the media of the clip's first frame.

anchor.description: The item point that `position` places and rotation turns around, in item units.

position.description: Offset of the anchor from the canvas center, in canvas units.

queries.summary: Get one item: summary, track, source, audio and visual properties

input_schema.description:
Lists the media of the project, filtered (also by bin folder) and ordered, one page at a
time. Each asset carries the name the bin shows and its folder.

folder.description:
Only assets in this folder of the bin; absent: the whole bin, or only its top level
with `recursive: false`.

oneOf.description: A video file (may also carry audio).
Another sequence of this project, used as a compound clip (arch §4.3).

anyOf.description: A non-negative duration in flicks (1/705600000 s) as an integer, or a string: seconds ("62.5s") or raw flicks ("123").
A non-negative duration in flicks (1/705600000 s) as an integer, or a string: seconds ("62.5s") or raw flicks ("123").

min_duration.description: Shortest length (flicks), inclusive; stills never match a bound.

problems.description: `true`: only files nothing can be read from (no streams).

recursive.description:
Include the subfolders' assets. Default: `true` without `folder` (the whole project),
`false` with one (that folder only); `false` without `folder` lists the top level.

text.description: Terms that must all occur in the file name, ignoring case and accents.

used.description: Placed on a timeline of any sequence (`true`) or not (`false`).

input_schema.title: MediaList

queries.name: media.list

matched.description: Number of assets that pass `filter` (all of them without one).

media.description: The page, in the requested order (default: by ID).

folder.description: The folder of the bin it is in; absent: the top level.

oneOf.description: A video file (may also carry audio).
Another sequence of this project, used as a compound clip (arch §4.3).

name.description: The name the bin shows: the display name, else the file name.

path.description: Absolute path when it was last found (file kinds).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

total.description: Number of assets in the project.

queries.summary: List the project's media (filter, sort, paged; default by id)

input_schema.description:
Lists the media bin's folder tree: each folder's ID, name, parent, path and how many
assets and subfolders it holds directly.
input_schema.title: MediaListFolders

queries.name: media.list_folders

folders.description:
Every folder, depth first: parents before their subfolders, siblings by name ignoring
case.

items.description: One folder of the media bin.

depth.description: Nesting depth: 1 at the top level.

parent.description: The folder it is in; absent at the top level.

path.description: Names from the top level down, joined with `/` (`B-roll/Drone`).

top_level_media.description: Assets at the top level of the bin (in no folder).

queries.summary: List the media bin's folder tree with paths and counts

input_schema.description: Returns the project name, format, media count and a summary of each sequence.
input_schema.title: ProjectInfo

queries.name: project.info

allowed_roots.description:
The folders agents may name in a path right now (import media from, open projects in,
save into): the folders the user allowed in Settings > Agents and MCP (or `--allow-root`)
and the project folders. Filled by the engine; empty outside one.

frame_rate.description: The edit grid: timecodes and `"f:N"` inputs resolve against it.

duration.description: End of the last item on any track.

frame_rate.description: The edit grid: timecodes and `"f:N"` inputs resolve against it.

item_count.description: Number of items on all its tracks.

queries.summary: Get project name, default format and a summary of its sequences

input_schema.description:
Reads a sequence in layers: `depth` 0 is the sequence summary, 1 adds its tracks (summaries
only, small), 2 adds every item. `fields` limits the sections returned (`name`, `format`,
`duration`, `tracks`); the id and the counts are always included.

fields.description: Sections to include: any of `name`, `format`, `duration`, `tracks` (default all).

input_schema.title: TimelineGet

queries.name: timeline.get

duration.description: End of the last item on any track (unless `fields` leaves it out).

frame_rate.description: The edit grid: timecodes and `"f:N"` inputs resolve against it.

item_count.description: Number of items on all tracks.

tracks.description:
The tracks in display order, top to bottom (depth >= 1, unless `fields` leaves them
out).

height.description: Row height in pixels; `None` is the default.

items.description: The items in start order (depth 2 only).

enabled.description: Whether the item is rendered and heard.

start.description: Timeline position of the first frame.

queries.summary: Get a sequence: summary (depth 0), tracks (1) or tracks with items (2)

input_schema.description: Lists a sequence's markers and its in/out range, or the markers of one item.

item.description: List this item's markers (item-relative times) instead of the sequence's.

input_schema.title: TimelineListMarkers

queries.name: timeline.list_markers

in_out.description: The sequence's in and out points (sequence markers only).

item.description: The item whose markers these are; absent for the sequence's own markers.

markers.description: The markers by time, then ID.

items.description: A marker on a sequence (sequence time) or an item (item-relative time).

duration.description: The length of a range marker; `None` for a point marker.

id.description: The marker ID (also its key in the owner's `markers`).

oneOf.description: Placed by a person or an agent.
A beat found by analysis (snaps like a marker, spec §6).
A chapter start (exported to chaptered formats).

label.description: Text shown with the marker (may be empty).

queries.summary: List the markers of a sequence (with its in/out range) or of one item

input_schema.description: Lists a sequence's tracks in display order with their flags, height and item counts.
input_schema.title: TrackList

queries.name: track.list

tracks.description: Its tracks in display order, top to bottom.

height.description: Row height in pixels; `None` is the default.

queries.summary: List a sequence's tracks (flags, height, item counts) top to bottom
